x: The National Executive of the Indian Socialist Party in 1946 A.D. demanded the dissolution of the Constituent Assembly and its re-election through universal adult suffrage. Socialist leaders such as Jayaprakash Narayan and Ram Manohar Lohia argued that the Constituent Assembly, which was indirectly elected by the Provincial Legislatures, did not adequately represent the common Indian people.
